parsed.rationale_overall: System A demonstrates stronger personalization by consistently tying recommendations to specific profile attributes (loss comfort 2/10, short horizon, tax bracket, monthly expenses) and provides more concrete, actionable steps with specific dollar amounts and tickers. System B contains some questionable claims (e.g., 6-8% expected return on dividend equities framed as low-risk, assuming IRA accounts not in the profile) and slightly less calibrated language, whereas System A's return ranges and trade-offs are more conservative and better grounded.
